_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in your personal data. This file is versioned; config.local.json is gitignored.
_room_groups: Sets of HA areas, said as one room. « tout », « toute la maison » and « partout » are built in (every room).
_vacuum_rooms: A robot vacuum's map, by its entity: the ids iRobot's app sends with a room cleaning, and each room's region on it (AD-107). Without one, it cleans only the whole home.
_building_doors: A building's street door, by the HA button that releases it, with the binary_sensor a ring at the flat turns on (AD-111). Opened by voice at any time; plain « ouvre la porte » is this door just after a ring. Without one, no such tool.
